title: Training Notes — The Deductible Line on a Pre-Placement Statement, Patient Financial Account
content:
**Rule taught.** On a pre-placement statement of the Patient Financial Account, the deductible line of the most recent encounter is shown only up to the recorded remaining deductible:

1. when the remaining deductible recorded on the account is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date recorded on the account is no more than the tier's re-verification period, in calendar days, before the handling date, the part of that line's open part above the recorded remaining deductible is left off;
2. when the recorded remaining deductible is above 0.00 and the coverage verified date is older than that, the line's whole open part is left off;
3. when the recorded remaining deductible is 0.00, nothing is left off under this rule.

This applies to the deductible line that is not inside the statement lead time; a deductible line already left off for the statement lead time is not left off a second time here.

**Re-verification period by class, in calendar days:** Medicaid Managed Care Account 30; Self-Pay Account 90; Medicare Part B Account 365; Medicare Advantage Account 90; Commercial HMO/EPO Account 90; Commercial PPO/POS Account 90; High-Deductible Health Plan Account 90.

**Terms.** The most recent encounter is the encounter whose deductible or coinsurance line was posted last. A line's open part is its amount less the payments posted against that line.

## Questions from training

**Q. Verification current (hypothetical figures).** Deductible line open part 520.00, recorded remaining deductible 350.00, verified 30 days ago on a 90-day class: 170.00 (the part above 350.00) is left off, and 350.00 of the line is shown.

**Q. Open part below the remaining deductible.** Open part 200.00, remaining deductible 350.00, verification current: no part lies above 350.00, so nothing is left off.

**Q. Verification stale.** The first case with the verification dated 91 days before the handling date on a 90-day class: the whole 520.00 is left off. Dated exactly 90 days before, it is still current.

**Q. Deductible met.** Recorded remaining deductible 0.00: nothing is left off under this rule.
